entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A Cabal dementia summoner who discovers the Mirari and rises through the Cabal's ranks, rivaling the Patriarch, before his fall.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Barbarian whose story continues on Otaria; befriends Chainer and trains as a pit fighter.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Plots to gain control of the Mer Empire for himself.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Black-aligned organization led by the Cabal Patriarch.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal, rivaled by Chainer.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent on which Kamahl's story continues.

events.summary: Chainer discovers the Mirari and rises through the Cabal, rivaling the Patriarch before his fall; Kamahl befriends him and Laquatus plots to seize the Mer Empire.
events.quote: Chainer's Torment presents the tale of Chainer , a Cabal dementia summoner, discovering the Mirari and rising through the ranks of the Cabal

relations.note: Befriends and fights beside him in the pits
